name: How long does it take to install closet lighting?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install closet lighting?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation time for closet lighting depends on the project's scope. A straightforward installation, like adding surface-mounted LED strips or puck lights to an existing outlet, might only take a few hours. More complex projects involving new wiring, recessed fixtures, or integrating with smart home systems can take a full day or even longer, especially if drywall work is involved. We can provide a time estimate after understanding the specifics of your closet and chosen lighting solution.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation can take a few hours for simple projects or a full day for complex wiring and recessed fixtures.
